### 🟡 Changes recommended JFlex generation must remove the obsolete generated source on incremental builds.
1 open finding - [Clear stale JFlex-generated files before regeneration](#discussion_r4226135407) · New
What changed in this PR Completes the 3.0 SQL query API and parser cleanup while preserving Couchbase telemetry behavior. **Changes:** - Replaces `createWithSummary` with a five-argument `create` factory. - Renames the JFlex-generated sanitizer and updates callers. - Adds factory, telemetry, parsing, and cache-lifecycle regression coverage. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `CHANGELOG.md` | Documents the breaking factory migration. | | `instrumentation-api-incubator/​build.gradle.kts` | Updates JFlex generation for the renamed sanitizer. | | `instrumentation-api-incubator/​src/​main/​jflex/​SqlSanitizer.jflex` | Renames the generated parser and factory calls. | | `instrumentation-api-incubator/​.../​SqlQuery.java` | Adds the full factory and restores public accessors. | | `instrumentation-api-incubator/​.../​SqlQueryAnalyzer.java` | Uses the renamed parser and factory. | | `instrumentation-api-incubator/​.../​SqlClientAttributesExtractor.java` | Removes obsolete deprecation suppression. | | `instrumentation-api-incubator/​.../​MultiQuery.java` | Removes obsolete suppression and comments. | | `instrumentation-api-incubator/​.../​DbClientSpanNameExtractor.java` | Removes obsolete deprecation suppression. | | `instrumentation-api-incubator/​.../​SqlQueryTest.java` | Tests factory semantics and truncation. | | `instrumentation-api-incubator/​.../​SqlQueryAnalyzerUtilCacheTest.java` | Renames and expands cache lifecycle tests. | | `instrumentation-api-incubator/​.../​SqlQueryAnalyzerTest.java` | Updates sanitizer and factory references. | | `instrumentation-api-incubator/​.../​SqlClientAttributesExtractorTest.java` | Tests operation and collection extraction. | | `instrumentation/​couchbase/​.../​CouchbaseRequestInfo.java` | Removes obsolete accessor suppression. | | `instrumentation/​couchbase/​.../​CouchbaseAttributesGetterTest.java` | Verifies copied-request telemetry. | | `instrumentation/​couchbase/​.../​CouchbaseQuerySanitizerTest.java` | Removes obsolete test suppression. |
🧠 **Review effort:** Balanced --- 💡 Add a `code-review` agent skill or configure MCP servers for context-aware, tailored reviews. Learn more in the docs.

[General] Renaming the JFlex input/class does not remove previously generated files from this output directory. On an incremental checkout, `AutoSqlSanitizerWithSummary.java` remains in the source set and still calls the removed `createWithSummary` methods, causing compilation to fail. Clear the generated directory before invoking JFlex.
